objective: Give every terminal family proof obligation an admissible, predeclared proof protocol so the global minimum-reality cut can be computed without inventing success criteria after seeing results.

universal_rules.same_scope: Brain and Opus 5.5 must be evaluated on the same frozen task population/harness/tool authority unless an absolute/theoretical ceiling is the proof mode.
universal_rules.ownership: Only the Brain-owned configured route counts for Brain. Opaque external target-capability providers are specimen evidence only.
universal_rules.knowledge: Both routes may use the same allowed JIT knowledge/tools where the family contract permits them.
universal_rules.contamination: Development evidence, protocol-design evidence, qualification evidence and final confirmation evidence must be partitioned before qualification.
universal_rules.statistics: For sampled binary/rubric outcomes, estimator, confidence interval, stopping rule and multiplicity control are frozen before results. Brain must meet the declared Opus bar or matched noninferiority/equal-or-better rule with the protocol's conservative acceptance statistic.
universal_rules.unknown: Missing result, incomparable harness, unresolved scorer disagreement, dirty evidence, or unknown dependency is FAIL_CLOSED_NOT_PROVEN.
universal_rules.no_proxy_substitution: A benchmark can prove only the behavioral scope it actually exercises. Additional leaves remain separate obligations.
